roles.name: Project Manager
success_checks: Assign clear responsibilities and timelines to each role
Summarize dependencies between frontend and backend work

roles.name: Designer
success_checks: UI spec describes layout, colors, typography, and interactions for Bug Busters
Wireframe conveys single-screen layout with score, timer, game area, and leaderboard section
Capitalizes on beginner-friendly instructions and simplicity

roles.name: Frontend Developer
success_checks: Implements clickable moving bug, score display, and 20-second timer
Integrates optional leaderboard fetch/post when backend available
No heavy frameworks; vanilla JS/CSS; code easy for beginners

roles.name: Backend Developer
success_checks: Exposes GET /health and GET/POST /scores with validation
Uses lightweight stack (e.g., Node/Express) and documents how to run

roles.name: Tester
success_checks: Test plan covers UI/game basics and API endpoints
Shell script verifies backend routes (health and score CRUD)
Instructions explain how to run tests after backend start

global_constraints: Game lasts 20 seconds and ends with final score display
Optional backend leaderboard limited to top 10 in memory
Files organized into clear folders (design/, frontend/, backend/, tests/)
Keep implementation approachable for beginners; no external DB
